info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Refunds API allows businesses to manage and retrieve information related to refunds for deliveries. Users can access detailed records of refunds associated with various delivery transactions, facilitating better financial management and customer service. This API serves delivery service operators and account managers who need to track refunds efficiently. It enables companies to address customer inquiries regarding refunds, improving transparency and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of delivery refunds that have been processed. You can use this information to assess the status and reasons for refunds issued to customers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for processing a refund for a delivery. Ensure to include all necessary details as outlined in the schema.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the Get Refund operations related to deliveries.
